process_findings.risk: Five free-agent tasks can fail after repeated retries when the daily quota is already exhausted.
process_findings.improvement: Run one cheap provider probe before fan-out; if it returns 429, skip free delegation and use cached audits or one paid/main-model pass.

process_findings.risk: Repeating unchanged semantic audits wastes tokens and can introduce regressions.
process_findings.improvement: Add a cache gate keyed by canonical target digest, rules version, and source digest; reuse a passed report when all keys match.

process_findings.finding: A single broad audit prompt asks agents to inspect 754 meanings and 1350 examples across 100 entries.
process_findings.risk: Low models may over-report stylistic preferences as defects.
process_findings.improvement: Use deterministic preflight first, then send only suspicious paths to semantic agents.
